name: Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
sourceServingsRule: One serving is intended for one person.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.amountRule: 1.5 eggs per serving, rounded up to a whole egg

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amountRule: 1.5–2 g per serving; includes the salt added to the eggs

steps.title: Prepare the tomatoes
steps.instruction: Wash the tomatoes. If desired, blanch and cool them to remove the skins. Remove the stems and cut into pieces no larger than 4 cm.

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.instruction: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add 1 g of the measured salt per serving and beat until combined.

steps.title: Cook and remove the eggs
steps.instruction: Heat the pan and add the oil. When hot, add the beaten eggs and stir-fry until set and slightly yellow. Turn off the heat and transfer the eggs to a plate. Do not wash the pan.

steps.title: Cook the tomatoes
steps.instruction: Turn the heat back on. Add the tomatoes, press them with the spatula and stir-fry for about 20 seconds, or until softened.

steps.title: Combine and season
steps.instruction: Return the eggs to the pan and stir to combine. Add the remaining measured salt, and the sugar and scallions if using. Stir well, turn off the heat and serve.
